previous_finding: S8 predictive practical-support gate failed with intervals including zero; primary economic gate failed and gross zero-cost wealth was below initial wealth.
remaining_problem: Separate weak predictive information from decision-horizon and joint-risk approximation error without selecting on closed outcomes.
question: Does a directly horizon-matched simple-return forecast with fixed shrinkage and one additional historical-context group improve a fully predeclared economic procedure against equal-weight, risk-only and unchanged-information controls?
hypothesis: A longer historical-context group improves subsequent simple-return calibration and net terminal wealth under the same policy, while a joint scenario policy improves use of a common forecast relative to the diagonal surrogate.
identification_warning: These are two separable hypotheses. Use crossed controls and do not attribute a policy improvement to memory or improved forecasting. No novelty is claimed.
material_difference: Forecast the realized simple total return at the exact policy holding endpoint, instead of extending weekly log coefficients across four intervals.
Make the entire feature/calibration/model/policy selection process part of a fixed nested chronological procedure.
Treat fixed averaging and zero-memory as legitimate incumbents; no new memory component in the first stage.

inputs.scope: A declared fixed instrument set with contemporaneous price, distribution and instrument metadata; any survivor/revision limitations retained.
inputs.base_features: The unchanged eight visible daily close-return observations, with actual availability and issue times.
inputs.one_added_group: Historical cumulative returns over 21, 63 and 126 observed trading sessions plus 21-session realized volatility and downside semivariance; train-only scaling and no forward fill. Freeze exact formulas before implementation.
inputs.cross_asset_features: Excluded from the first added group; a later separately declared hypothesis.
inputs.targets: Simple total return from actual execution to the directly forecast holding endpoint, including declared distribution treatment; primary H=1 continuous weekly interval, H=4 prespecified diagnostic head only.
inputs.actual_horizon: Record number of sessions and elapsed seconds per target; purge training and calibration on label availability, not merely origin date.

models.primary: Direct ridge conditional mean with train-only feature scaling and a finite historical joint residual-scenario distribution.
excluded_first_stage: Fundamental or macro fields without timestamped vintages
models.calibration: Identity incumbent plus a fixed chronological inner choice among shrinkage strengths 0, 0.5 and 1; separate mean and scale diagnostics. No outer-window choice.
models.refit: Quarterly expanding refit versus frozen model as a declared ablation; all training/calibration labels strictly available before issue. Residual scenarios rebuilt with out-of-fit predictions and model-version identities.

decision_layer.primary: Finite empirical joint-scenario expected log-growth objective with explicit self-financing transaction costs, cash sleeve and an unchanged long-only 80 percent risk-budget / one-third asset-cap contract.
decision_layer.interpretation: Exact expectation under the declared finite scenario distribution only; no claim it is exact expected utility under the true market law.
controls: Unchanged S8 diagonal surrogate with the same horizon and forecasts
Equal-weight 80 percent assets / 20 percent cash at the same review times
Covariance-based minimum-risk allocation with the same constraints
decision_layer.joint_risk: Keep contemporaneous asset residuals together. Any tail flooring, total-loss mass or re-centering is part of the model and must be disclosed and validated.
decision_layer.fees: 10 bps one-way primary, 0/20/40 bps sensitivity; fixed-position fee bridge reported separately from policy response.
decision_layer.cash_yield: Dated cash-return observations with availability evidence if supplied. Otherwise zero-cash-yield exploratory scope must remain explicit.
decision_layer.liability_use: Excluded from return-advantage claims until a separate dated mandate simulation is admitted; preserve the existing liability-first plan.

success_contract.primary_economic_estimand: Candidate terminal wealth / matched benchmark terminal wealth - 1 over the full fixed outer horizon, with identical starting wealth, cash flows, costs and liquidation convention.
success_contract.point_claim: Report point uplift separately for every benchmark. A target claim requires at least 6 percent for each predeclared required comparator, without choosing the comparator after results.
success_contract.support_claim: A stronger reliability claim additionally requires a predeclared procedure-level uncertainty lower bound above 6 percent for the full required family; planning must justify that precision before any protected use.
success_contract.predictive_claim: Original memory hypothesis retains 0.01 nats per observation for matched log-density scores and all existing fixed interval families. A different forecast scale or non-density model must not silently reuse that numerical threshold; predeclare a separate predictive endpoint without claiming it tests the original memory hypothesis.
success_contract.risk_constraints: No leverage or shorts; identical per-asset caps, risky-exposure ceiling, costs, review calendar and cash-flow dates; report turnover, drawdown, exposure and downside jointly with wealth.

selection_and_statistics.selection: Nested expanding chronological folds; fit features, model, calibration and any selected policy only inside the inner folds. Purge by complete label maturity plus actual publication lag.
selection_and_statistics.protected_boundary: 2025-01-01: no access or implied permission from this proposal
selection_and_statistics.units: Common decision date with all contemporaneous assets; asset rows and optimization seeds are not independent financial histories.
selection_and_statistics.conditional_intervals: May describe saved forecast/decision paths only and must be labeled conditional.
selection_and_statistics.procedure_uncertainty: Evaluate fitting and inner selection inside every declared outer fold; retain dependence across folds. Do not claim ordinary iid nested-CV or a saved-score bootstrap supplies calibrated financial procedure intervals.
selection_and_statistics.precision_gate: Estimate serial dependence and effective blocks from permitted pre-existing development data only, report uncertainty of the estimate, and perform a prespecified simulation-based precision/power analysis. No numerical required sample size is asserted without that calculation.
selection_and_statistics.multiplicity: One primary economic procedure and a fixed required benchmark family. Secondary predictive, feature, policy and memory claims remain separate families; no best-arm replacement.

budget.fallback: If complete fixed matrix cannot fit the resource/data/precision contract, record incomplete and stop; no omitted failing arms or optional expansion.

falsifiers: Added information does not improve declared subsequent mean/ranking calibration against unchanged information.
Joint policy fails to improve the same forecast under the same constraints.
Minimum economic uplift fails for any required comparator.
Any claimed adaptive-memory increment fails against fixed/global/recent controls in a separate memory experiment.
Chronology, data or accounting defect invalidates the affected test and requires an additive corrected freeze, not deletion.
run_ready_gates: A real unconsumed outer dataset/window with documented exposure status, not a new download name for inspected outcomes.
Source timestamps, total returns, cash assumptions and rights fit the intended claim.
Precision analysis shows that the bounded design can distinguish the stated practical target; otherwise close as inconclusive.
Exact formulas, model/calibration/refit rules, scenario generation and solver tolerances implemented and independently checked.
Complete numerical, chronology, accounting and pipeline tests plus a measured bounded dry run.
Complete source/data/environment/analysis freeze and append-only consumption receipt before outcomes.
Resource admission or an applicable explicit existing waiver; no unrelated-process termination.
current_recommendation: Do not run new market fits now. Finish and preserve the existing negative/inconclusive package and implement only reviewable, outcome-independent methodology repairs if useful. No defined unconsumed outer window or procedure-level precision evidence currently supports spending the protected tail.
